summary.es: Superportaaviones de asalto de la RDF que, tras ser arrastrado al espacio por el salto accidental del SDF-1, fue adaptado como su brazo babor y principal cubierta de vuelo para los cazas Veritech durante toda la Primera Guerra Robotech.
summary.en: RDF heavy strike carrier that, after being swept into deep space by the SDF-1's accidental fold, was mated as its port arm and primary flight deck for Veritech fighter wings throughout the First Robotech War.

faction.en: U.N. Spacy // Robotech Defense Force (RDF)

summary.es: Nave de asalto anfibio de la RDF adaptada como brazo estribor del SDF-1 Macross. Célebre por el devastador 'Ataque Daedalus', donde su proa acorazada embestía naves enemigas para disparar decenas de Destroids a quemarropa en su interior.
summary.en: RDF amphibious assault ship adapted as the starboard arm of the SDF-1 Macross. World-renowned for the devastating 'Daedalus Attack', ramming enemy ships to fire scores of Destroid cannons directly into their hulls.

class_name.en: ARMD-Class Armored Space Defense Platform & Carrier

faction.en: U.N. Spacy // Robotech Defense Force (RDF)

summary.es: Plataforma espacial de asalto y portanaves orbital de la RDF. Diseñadas originalmente para ser los brazos del SDF-1, formaron la principal barrera de defensa orbital de la Tierra durante la Primera Guerra Robotech.
summary.en: RDF orbital strike carrier and space defense platform. Originally engineered to serve as the SDF-1's arms, they formed Earth's front-line orbital defense shield during the First Robotech War.

class_name.en: Oberth-Class Light Space Destroyer & Patrol Cruiser

faction.en: U.N. Spacy // Robotech Defense Force (RDF)

summary.es: Destructor espacial ligero y crucero de patrulla de la RDF. La primera generación de naves de combate espacial humanas que defendió valientemente el perímetro lunar y marciano durante la Primera Guerra Robotech.
summary.en: RDF light space destroyer and patrol cruiser. Humanity's first generation of space combat vessels that valiantly defended the lunar and Martian perimeters during the First Robotech War.

class_name.en: Megaroad-Class Super Dimensional Battle Fortress & Deep-Space Flagship

faction.es: U.N. Spacy // Tierra Unificada
faction.en: U.N. Spacy // United Earth Government

summary.es: Segunda fortaleza superdimensional construida en la Tierra para viajar hacia las estrellas bajo el mando de Lisa Hayes. Trágicamente destruida en New Macross City por la embestida suicida de Khyron, sus planos dieron origen al SDF-3 Pioneer.
summary.en: Second super dimensional fortress built on Earth to journey to deep space under Commander Lisa Hayes. Tragically destroyed in New Macross City by Khyron's suicide ramming, its design birthed the SDF-3 Pioneer.

class_name.es: Fortaleza Móvil y Centro de Mando Supremo Imperial Clase Fulbtzs-Berrentzs
class_name.en: Fulbtzs-Berrentzs-Class Mobile Fortress & Supreme Imperial Flagship

faction.es: Gran Armada Imperial Zentraedi (Flota de Dolza)
faction.en: Grand Imperial Zentraedi Armada (Dolza's Grand Fleet)

summary.es: La colosal fortaleza móvil de 1.400 km de Dolza y centro de mando de la armada imperial de 4.8 millones de naves Zentraedi. Destruida por el SDF-1 desde su núcleo interno en el clímax de la Primera Guerra Robotech.
summary.en: Dolza's titanic 1,400km mobile base fortress and supreme command hub for the 4.8 million Zentraedi Grand Fleet armada. Obliterated from the inside out by the SDF-1 during the climax of the First Robotech War.

class_name.es: Acorazado Insignia de Mando de Flota Clase Nupetiet-Vergnitzs (Nave de Breetai)
class_name.en: Nupetiet-Vergnitzs-Class Fleet Command Battleship (Breetai's Flagship)

faction.es: Flota Imperial Zentraedi // Flota Aliada de Breetai
faction.en: Zentraedi Imperial Fleet // Breetai's Allied Fleet

summary.es: Acorazado insignia de 4 km del Comandante Breetai y Exedore. Persiguió al SDF-1 por todo el Sistema Solar antes de sellar la alianza histórica con la humanidad para destruir la flota de Dolza.
summary.en: Commander Breetai's 4km-long flagship. Pursued the SDF-1 across the Solar System before forging the historic peace alliance with humanity to annihilate Dolza's armada.

class_name.es: Crucero Pesado de Batalla y Asalto Modular Clase Queadol-Magdomilla (Nave de Khyron)
class_name.en: Queadol-Magdomilla-Class Heavy Assault Strike Cruiser (Khyron's Flagship)

faction.es: 7º Batallón Experimental Zentraedi // Fuerzas Rebeldes de Khyron
faction.en: 7th Experimental Zentraedi Division // Khyron's Rebel Legion

summary.es: Crucero de asalto pesado de 3 km con proa desmontable comandado por Khyron. Célebre por sus despiadadas emboscadas y por la embestida suicida final que destruyó tanto al SDF-1 como al SDF-2 en New Macross City.
summary.en: Khyron's 3km heavy assault cruiser featuring a detachable bow strike gunship. Renowned for ruthless ambushes and the suicidal ramming run that destroyed both the SDF-1 and SDF-2 in New Macross City.

class_name.es: Acorazado Estándar de Asalto y Destructor de Línea Zentraedi Clase Thuverl-Salan
class_name.en: Thuverl-Salan-Class Standard Assault Battleship & Line Destroyer

faction.es: Gran Armada Imperial Zentraedi // Flotas de Combate de Línea
faction.en: Grand Zentraedi Imperial Armada // Frontline Battlefleets

summary.es: El acorazado de línea de 2 km más numeroso y destructivo de la flota Zentraedi. Columna vertebral artillera del imperio, desplegaba cientos de cápsulas Regult en combate.
summary.en: The most numerous and destructive 2km frontline battleship of the Zentraedi empire. Formed the artillery backbone of the armada, deploying hundreds of Regult pods in combat.

class_name.es: Fragata de Exploración Profunda y Vigilancia de Sensores Clase Chul-Gautsn
class_name.en: Chul-Gautsn-Class Deep-Space Scout & Reconnaissance Frigate

faction.en: Zentraedi Imperial Fleet // Advanced Reconnaissance Squadrons

summary.es: Nave de exploración y espionaje de 500 m de la flota Zentraedi. Rastreó al SDF-1 por el sistema solar y albergó la cámara de micronización de los tres espías que descubrieron la cultura humana.
summary.en: Zentraedi 500m reconnaissance and scout frigate. Tracked the SDF-1 across the solar system and housed the micronization chamber for the three spies who discovered human culture.

class_name.es: Acorazado Insignia de Combate Meltrandi Clase Queadol-Quilna (Nave de Azonia)
class_name.en: Queadol-Quilna-Class Meltrandi Heavy Assault Battleship (Azonia's Flagship)

faction.en: Meltrandi Female Battlefleet // Azonia's Command Division

summary.es: Acorazado insignia de 3,3 km de la flota femenina Meltrandi comandado por Azonia. Base de operaciones de las armaduras Queadluun-Rau de Miriya Parina, combatió al SDF-1 antes de unirse a la alianza contra Dolza.
summary.en: Commander Azonia's 3.3km flagship of the female Meltrandi fleet. Staging base for Miriya Parina's Queadluun-Rau power armor, it fought the SDF-1 before joining the allied fleet against Dolza.

summary.en: Southern Cross heavy line battlecruiser, critical in orbital defensive formations and heavy artillery support against the Tirolian warships.

summary.en: Colossal 6km city-ship and supreme fortress of the Robotech Masters. Journeyed across the stars to Earth to seize Zor's Protoculture matrix before the arrival of the Invid.

summary.en: Fast light escort cruiser built around a massive axial particle beam cannon, essential for fleet convoy escort and atmospheric drop missions.

summary.en: Next-generation heavy battleship equipped with Shadow cloaking and synchro cannons. Major Vince Grant's UES Icarus led the search for the missing SDF-3 and broke the Haydonite ambush.

summary.en: Colossal 1,350m super fortress armed with four synchro cannons and the cataclysmic Neutron-S missile payload. Supreme flagship of the Final Assault Fleet at Reflex Point.

summary.en: Tactical dropship and orbital assault transporter capable of deploying Alpha Fighters, Cyclone armor units, and assault troops directly into Invid combat zones.

summary.en: Colossal 12km organic hive fortress and supreme planetary sanctum of the Invid Regis on Earth. Epicenter of the Genesis Pits and final destination of the Third Robotech War.

summary.en: Over 300m organic assault dropship used by the Invid to ferry and rapidly deploy over a hundred Shock Troopers onto conquered worlds.

class_name.en: Haydonite Cybernetic Stealth Dreadnought
